production_measurement.note: The population and the settlement row count are what make pagination mandatory rather than precautionary: a 500-pick chunk can hold far more than PostgREST's default 1000-row page, and a truncated page does not raise -- it silently omits picks, which reads as 'no settlement exists' and makes the caller settle an already-settled pick.
